validity.recommendation: Correct LengthKnown from 170 km to 340 km (the per-line route length); the same correction applies to the parallel line P6726 ('#4') and likely the whole halved East-West cluster.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real. This is Package 7 of Aramco's Master Gas System Phase 3 (MGS-3) expansion, a $10bn / 4,153 km project. Package 7 (EWPS-6 to EWPS-8) was awarded to Sinopec International Petroleum Services as part of a combined Packages 6+7 contract worth $1.4bn, mechanical completion expected May 31 2027 (OGJ). EWPS = East-West Pipeline Station. Construction commenced Q2 2024; project completion Q4 2028. CLASSIFICATION: confirmed gas transmission trunk line (Master Gas System east-west trunk, dry gas), correctly classified. OWNER: Aramco, confirmed. DIAMETER: 56-inch, confirmed by MEED, Blackridge and OGJ. STATUS: construction, confirmed. SPEC CONCERN (length): GEM records P6725 ('line 3') = 170 km and P6726 ('line 4') = 170 km. Two INDEPENDENT sources describe Package 7 as 'laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines THREE AND FOUR from EWPS-6 to EWPS-8, covering 340 km' (MEED), and 'Lay 56-inch diameter pipelines (EWGP-3 and EWGP-4) from EWPS-6 to EWPS-8 (340km)' (Blackridge). The 340 km is the ROUTE length along which BOTH parallel lines (3 and 4) run, i.e. each line is ~340 km, not two 170 km half-lines. Corroborated by OGJ: Sinopec's combined Packages 6+7 total 696 km (Pkg 6 = 370 km EWPS-4-EWPS-6 + Pkg 7 = 340 km EWPS-6-EWPS-8 = ~710 km of ROUTE, treating the figures as per-route not per-pipe). GEM has systematically HALVED every dual-line east-west package: Pkg3 56->28/28, Pkg4 300->150/150, Pkg5 166->83/83, Pkg6 370->185/185, Pkg7 340->170/170. So GEM's 170 km is half the correct per-line length of 340 km. Recommend correcting LengthKnown to 340 km for both P6725 and P6726 (and reviewing the whole cluster). Not a duplicate of another PID: P6725 ('line 3') and P6726 ('line 4') are two genuinely distinct parallel pipes in the same trench, not a double-count.

fills.researcher_notes: Location [ref] was blank in GEM (only the two country cells = Saudi Arabia, no endpoint ref). Package 7 runs EWPS-6 to EWPS-8 (East-West Pipeline Stations 6 and 8). Both endpoints named identically by MEED and Blackridge. Province not separately specified by sources (route crosses central/eastern Saudi Arabia), left blank rather than guessed.

summary: P6725 (MGS-3 Package 7 EWPS-6-EWPS-8 line 3) is real, correctly classified gas transmission, Aramco, 56-in, under construction; but GEM length 170 km is HALF the correct per-line route length of 340 km (systematic halving of every dual-line E-W package) - spec concern, high tier.
